repaired.name: Scenario
repaired.script:
fired := false
if (fired == true) {
wait until(any(#HumiditySensor).humiditySensor_humidity >= 50)
fired = false
}
wait until(any(#HumiditySensor).humiditySensor_humidity < 50)
any(#Dehumidifier).dehumidifier_setDehumidifierMode("drying")
fired = true

diagnosis.summary: The IR requires a rising-edge wait for Humidity < 50 (waiting for the value to drop below 50). The candidate waits for Humidity >= 50 (waiting for the value to rise above 50), which is the opposite condition. Additionally, the candidate uses `all(#HumiditySensor)` in the wait condition, but the binding slot for HumiditySensor is `any`, meaning the IR waits for *any* sensor to drop below 50, whereas the candidate waits for *all* sensors to be above 50. This causes the JoI to miss the initial firing at t=0 where Main_HumiditySensor is 0.0 (below 50).
diagnosis.change_summary: Changed the rising-edge wait condition from `>= 50` to `< 50` to match the IR. Changed the selector from `all(#HumiditySensor)` to `any(#HumiditySensor)` to match the binding slot. Changed the action target from `all(#Dehumidifier)` to `any(#Dehumidifier)` to match the binding slot.
